scope: One current negative observation only; prior20 e and positive current e unchanged. Not a new recursive PVR. Re-evaluate from original E each date.
clock: All features after t close; original next-common-open contract unchanged. Current and immediately preceding common day source/factor/validity checked; original past scale inherits exact original PVR calculation.
scale: Original s=max(1e-8,1.4826*median(abs(r) over prior63 original valid observations)); units log return; q dimensionless. No new clipping, epsilon or coefficient. q and Q mathematically unbounded when s tiny. Scope diagnostic must disclose observed extremes; do not promote merely because cases work.
ranking: Same event, known slots reordered Q desc then PVR desc sid; unknown retains exact original PVR numeric slot. Same K, initial trial, adds and exit; no hard gate or waiting. Original nonnegative next current return removes extra current penalty, no permanent damage memory.
stage: Freeze feature/rank computation; initially inspect units, denominator and score/selection changes on cases before deciding whether any full outcome comparison is warranted.
history: All baseline outcomes and selected fixed paired cases already inspected. Development history, not unseen OOS.
